environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind API Gateway (REST API) in us-east-1. Lambda has default execution role with VPC configuration using public subnets with NAT gateway. No WAF attached to the API Gateway stage. API Gateway throttling set to default (10000 req/s burst). Lambda has outbound internet access and can reach the EC2 instance metadata service at 169.254.169.254. IMDSv1 is enabled on the underlying infrastructure. No network ACLs restricting Lambda's outbound traffic to link-local addresses.

config.vpc: public subnets with NAT, no restrictive security groups on outbound
